thread:
Alex W: Quick follow-up from last night's p99 latency incident — tracking owners/timelines for postmortem remediation and SLO updates. See postmortem: https://docs.google.com/.../postmortem. Can we list actionable owners and target dates? I'll kick off.

Maria G: Thanks. I propose: (1) dashboard cleanup + throttling alerts -> owner: Chen L -> due Mon 3/30; (2) add synthetic canary and latency SLO recalibration -> owner: Olivia P -> due Fri 3/27; (3) runbook update + rollback criteria -> owner: Alex W -> due Wed 3/25.

Chen L: I can own dashboard + alerts. Which metrics? p99 over 1s, p95 over 300ms, error-rate spikes. Adding query:
```
sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{le="1"}[5m])) / sum(rate(request_count[5m]))
```
Will add panels and set pager threshold at p99>1.2s.

Olivia P: I'll add the synthetic canary (region eu-west1 first). Suggest SLO: 99.5% p95 < 350ms and 99.0% p99 < 1.0s for dedicated tier. Reason: error budget burnt 0.6% last 7d. Will demo new dashboard in #eng-platform.

SRE-Bot: Incident summary: alert p99_latency_high fired 2026-03-18 02:14 UTC. Peak p99=1.6s, error_budget_burn=0.62%. Tags: service=inference, region=us-west1.

Alex W: Chen and Olivia, can you also add an 'SLO change proposal' section in the postmortem doc? We need one-paragraph rationale + rollback plan.

Chen L: Ack. I'll add the refs + link to the grafana panels. Assigning myself for alerts and dashboard by 1852680000 (Mon).

Maria G: I'm adding a recurring cadence: 2-week check-ins on SLOs for next 8 weeks, owner rotation: Alex -> week1, Chen -> week2, Olivia -> week3. Add calendar invites?

Olivia P: Calendar invite created: 'SLO follow-up cadence' weekly Wed 10:30 PT, 6 occurrences. Added agenda: trend review, new regressions, action items.

Alex W: For remediation timelines, we should separate 'short fixes (<48h)' vs 'engine changes (2-6w)'. Short fixes: alert thresholds, cache warmup tuning, throttling. Engine work: KV cache eviction improvements, batching heuristics.

Maria G: Action tracker (Google Sheet) updated. Columns: action, owner, priority, status, target_date. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/xyz

Chen L: Quick note: I found recurring pattern — latency spikes correlate with model warmup after autoscale events. Adding to postmortem under 'recurring patterns' and creating an experiment ticket.

Olivia P: I'm going to propose a canary rollout policy change: hold new model version behind 5% traffic canary with latency gating for 48h. Will draft RFC.

Alex W: Thanks all. Next steps: update postmortem by EOD, set targets in Redwood SLO service, and confirm error budget burn projection next check-in. :thumbsup:
